justification: Title-only record: 'fail fast, or ask' names failure detection and deferral to a human as the gate; an engineering proposal with no study reported, hence solution_proposal.
Title names LLM feedback loops re-generating code on diagnostics, an audit of that one mechanism; it is a lab case study of a C-to-Rust prototype, not deployed practice, so validation_research.
Contribution is self-refinement of the vision-language model itself via triangular consistency, an outer loop training on its own outputs; NeurIPS lab benchmark work, so validation_research.
Headline artefact is a benchmark measuring self-correction behaviour, an instrument rather than a loop mechanism; benchmark construction and lab runs, so validation_research.
Contribution is modularized workflow automation that reallocates subtasks across agents, i.e. the arrangement itself; ICLR lab benchmark evaluation, so validation_research.
AFlow rewrites the agent's own workflows from execution feedback across iterations (runner-up deliberative_search for its MCTS); lab benchmark evaluation, so validation_research.
An automatically learned reward model scores sampled candidate trajectories so planning selects among them; validated on lab benchmarks, not in deployment, so validation_research.
Headline artefact is a hop-aware diagnostic benchmark for agentic RAG, an instrument that generalises past one mechanism; lab benchmark construction, so validation_research.
Title foregrounds self-refinement of parallel reasoning, the revision applied after candidates exist rather than the check; lab reasoning benchmarks, so validation_research.
Contribution is how the self-reflection critique is produced (an information-theoretic signal) so the response is rewritten; lab evaluation on small LMs, so validation_research.
Verification is by off-the-shelf per-constraint checkers while the claim is the divide-verify-refine correction loop (runner-up verification_and_gating); lab benchmarks, so validation_research.
The ASP solver is an off-the-shelf checker; the claim is the self-correction loop rewriting programs from its diagnostics; lab benchmark work only, so validation_research.
Meeseeks is a benchmark instrument for measuring iterative self-correction, not a mechanism contribution; benchmark construction and lab runs, so validation_research.
An empirical audit of one named mechanism, self-correction, decomposed into confidence and critique abilities; measured on lab datasets, so validation_research not evaluation_research.
Empirical audit of why intrinsic self-correction fails, which the scheme assigns to critique_and_revision; conditions varied in lab experiments, so validation_research.
Object studied is ChatGPT's self-correction of simplified reports; radiologists judge lab outputs rather than a deployed system, so validation_research with a human_study.
PROTEA evaluates a multi-agent workflow offline and iteratively rewrites it, an outer loop changing the agent (runner-up loop_evaluation_and_diagnosis); lab validation, so validation_research.
Contribution is evolutionary branching over decoding candidates with a refined value function selecting among them; lab benchmark evaluation, so validation_research.
Contribution makes memory writes and eviction explicit actions curating context across long horizons; lab benchmark evaluation, so validation_research.
Contribution is a pre-execution policy gate deciding whether an agent action may proceed; adherence is measured on lab benchmarks rather than in company deployment, so validation_research.
Title's object is the cost-performance trade-off of running self-refinement on cheaper open models, i.e. what the loop is worth spending (runner-up critique_and_revision); lab exploration.
Contribution is a probabilistic theory of how successive self-correction rounds change accuracy; the theory is checked against lab benchmark results, so validation_research.
A2Flow searches self-adaptive abstraction operators to rewrite agentic workflows between runs (runner-up deliberative_search); lab benchmark evaluation, so validation_research.
